FAQs

What is the difference between registering with an account and registering with a bank card?

When you register with your account and credit card, you will be able to view all banking products in your banking profile and also have access to all our online/mobile banking services.

When you register with your bank card, you will only have access to the details and services of the bank card.

I registered for Online Banking and Mobile Banking using my credit card. If I apply for other bank products will I see them when I log in?

If you’ve registered for Online and Mobile Banking using your credit card, you’ll only see details related to your credit card. To view all your banking products, you’ll need to register for Online and Mobile Banking again using your account. Call us on +971 600 54 0000, and we’ll help set that up for you.
